name: Webdevez Testimonials Slider for Elementor
author: kishorrajpurohit

sections.description:
Webdevez Testimonials Slider for Elementor is a modern and advanced Elementor addon designed to showcase client testimonials, ratings, reviews, and video feedback in a professional and engaging way.

Whether you want a clean minimalist testimonial section or a fully interactive video testimonial slider, this plugin provides beautifully crafted layouts with deep customization options directly inside Elementor.

Built with performance, flexibility, and responsiveness in mind, the plugin helps businesses improve trust, social proof, and user engagement on their websites.

Features

  • 4 Unique Responsive Layout Templates
  • Text Testimonials Support
  • Video Testimonials Support (YouTube & Vimeo)
  • Native Elementor Widget Integration
  • Fully Responsive Design
  • Swiper.js Powered Touch Slider
  • Advanced Typography & Styling Controls
  • Custom Colors, Backgrounds & Spacing
  • Loop, Autoplay & Navigation Controls
  • Mobile Optimized Layouts
  • Lightweight & Fast Loading
  • Translation Ready (i18n Support)
  • Secure & Optimized Code Structure

Elementor Integration

The plugin works seamlessly with Elementor Page Builder and adds a dedicated testimonial slider widget directly into the Elementor editor panel.

You can simply drag and drop the widget onto any page and start customizing testimonials visually without coding.

Video Testimonials

The plugin supports:

  • YouTube Video Testimonials
  • Vimeo Video Testimonials
  • Self Hosted MP4 Videos

You can easily switch between text and video testimonial types for each testimonial item.

Fully Customizable

Customize everything directly from Elementor:

  • Typography
  • Colors
  • Star Ratings
  • Card Backgrounds
  • Padding & Margin
  • Border Radius
  • Navigation Styling
  • Slider Speed & Controls

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later license.

Author

Developed by Kishor Rajpurohit

Website:
https://webdevez.in
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/webdevez-testimonials-slider-for-elementor/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure Elementor Page Builder is installed and activated.
  4. Open any page using Elementor.
  5. Search for “Webdevez Testimonials Slider for Elementor”.
  6. Drag and drop the widget into your page.
  7. Add testimonials and customize the slider settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor Page Builder must be installed and activated to use this plugin.

Does it support video testimonials?

Yes. The plugin supports YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted MP4 video testimonials.

Is the plugin mobile responsive?

Absolutely. All testimonial layouts are fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I customize colors and typography?

Yes. You can customize typography, colors, spacing, backgrounds, borders, and more directly inside Elementor.

Does it use Swiper.js?

Yes. The slider is powered by Swiper.js for smooth and touch-friendly performance.
